verdict.rationale: Marqeta provides an extensive documented Core API (cards, transactions, controls, disputes, webhooks) with an interactive sandbox and widgets for testing endpoints directly, clearly enabling programmatic/AI-native use. Probes show no discoverable openapi.json/llms.txt at standard paths, but a full documented public API surface is otherwise well evidenced. Missing for 10: a discoverable machine-readable OpenAPI spec or llms.txt at standard endpoints, independent third-party corroboration of API usability.
